p1: For three nights, a man slept in a motel bed. There was a body underneath it.
It sounds like an urban legend. It really happened. Kansas City, July 2003.
A guest checks into the Capri Motel. His room has a horrible smell.
He complains. Management says nothing can be done about the odor.
So he stays. Three nights. Then he checks out.
Cleaners come in to make up the room. They lift the mattress.
Hidden behind the wooden panels around the base of the bed... a body.
Police couldn't say who it was. No one was arrested.
And it happened again. Memphis, 2010. A missing woman, found inside a motel bed frame.
That room was rented out about five times after she disappeared.
So tonight... check under your bed. Follow for more true stories.
